result.description:
Data Engineer
Trading under Publicis Communications
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Data Engineer (also known as BI Developer, Quantitative Data Engineer, Search Engineer, Technical Architect, Big Data Analyst, Solutions Architect, Data Warehouse Engineer, Data Science Software Engineer, ETL Developer)
The role of the Data Engineer is to work alongside solution architects, data analysts & data scientists to deliver various aspects of the marketing technology ecosystem. The Data Engineer is responsible for engaging machine learning techniques to create and sustain structures that allow for the analysis of data whilst remaining familiar with dominant programming and deployment strategies. Data engineering experience is critical, as well as knowledge of data warehousing, ETL strategies and tools, and BI tools. Experience in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP is beneficial.
Data Engineer Responsibilities:
•	Anticipating and mitigating delivery risks and following issues through to closure
•	Advocating for data management methodologies and processes on all projects
•	Assuming responsibility for data quality, ensuring that testing is carried out in a rigorous fashion resulting in production of high-quality deliverables
•	Adopting a flexible approach to completing workload to ensuring timely delivery and reinforcing commitment to delivery and quality within the technical team, including offshore development centres 
•	Creating and managing the relevant technical design documentation and ensures the documents completeness and accuracy
•	Ensuring that data architecture is implemented according to the design 
•	Ensuring solutions delivered use existing standards and frameworks
•	Contributing to business development efforts through accurate project scoping, estimating and attending sales calls when required
•	Collaborating with globally dispersed teams on international projects.  This includes co-ordinating build activities with offshore development centres in India and Asia Pacific
•	Remaining up-to-date with industry standards and technological advancements that will improve the quality of your outputs.
Data Engineer Requirements:
•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Proven experience as a data engineer, software developer, or similar.
•	Expert proficiency in Python, C++, Java, R, and SQL.
•	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Works well independently but also a team player and able to work collaboratively
•	Scrupulous approach to duties.
•	Strong presentation and written communication skills, with ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and clients
•	Experience developing data processing and analytics solutions in a digital agency or IT consultancy as part of a multi-disciplinary team
Salary over threshold

Sonar develops and implements software products that automate operational workflows across transport and logistics, mobile workforce management, warehousing, field services, retail and healthcare. Its solutions provide capabilities such as job scheduling, dispatch management, route optimisation, real-time tracking, inventory management, reporting and integration with existing ERP and CRM platforms.   About the Role   The role will primarily involve C# and .NET application development, API integration, database-driven software solutions and the deployment of applications through modern cloud and container environments.   Key Responsibilities    Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and existing application workflows.  Develop, maintain and enhance software applications using C#, .NET and related technologies.  Design, develop and test APIs used to integrate Sonar applications with customer, ERP, CRM and third-party systems.  Write maintainable and appropriately documented program code in accordance with technical specifications and development standards.  Identify limitations and deficiencies in existing applications and recommend suitable software improvements.  Test, debug and correct application errors to ensure systems perform reliably and according to specification.  Assist in upgrading legacy .NET applications and APIs to current frameworks and development standards.  Develop and maintain database-driven functionality using SQL and relational database technologies.  Develop and maintain automated build, testing and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines.  Assist with the deployment and operation of applications in cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.  Monitor application performance, investigate runtime issues and implement software-level fixes.  Develop internal utilities and automation tools using technologies such as Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash. Experience with REST APIs and system integration.  Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.  Familiarity with CI/CD tools and source-control platforms such as Bitbucket or Git.    Desirable Skills    Experience modernising legacy .NET applications.  Experience developing software for logistics, workforce management, warehousing, healthcare or other operational environments. MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Transform lives, every single day 

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen. 

We're a well-respected not-for-profit that's been serving society's most vulnerable for more than 160 years. Each year, we achieve life-changing outcomes for the 40,000+ people who rely on our person-centred support. And now, we're extending our reach and impact even further. 

As an Integration Developer, you'll play a key role in delivering secure, scalable and efficient technology solutions that support our mission. You'll be welcomed into a compassionate, respectful and purpose-driven community where we don't just talk about values - we live them. 

Your opportunity 

You will design, develop and maintain enterprise integration solutions that connect Anglicare's systems and services. Working closely with stakeholders across IT, Finance, Payroll, PaC and Facilities, you'll ensure our data flows securely and reliably to support business operations. 

With integrity and resilience, you will: 

Collaborate with business units to gather and document integration requirements 

Develop and maintain Logic App integrations aligned with enterprise architecture and security standards 

Deliver robust, well-tested solutions using Azure services including API Management and Functions 

Monitor and optimise the Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) platform 

Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues, ensuring minimal disruption to services 

Maintain system and data security, including access controls and disaster recovery documentation 

Support stakeholders with integration needs and provide clear, timely communication 

What you'll bring 

You are a detail-oriented, technically capable developer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You bring strong experience in Azure integration technologies and a passion for building secure, scalable solutions. 

You will also need: 

A degree in IT or relevant industry experience 

2+ years' experience working in Azure and developing Logic Apps (or Power Automate) 

Experience with Azure API Management, Azure Functions, REST-SOAP APIs and Postman 

Familiarity with CI-CD pipelines and code repositories 

Strong communication and documentation skills 

Experience integrating with Workday HCM and using Workday Studio (desirable) 

Knowledge of .NET and Azure scripting languages (desirable) 

Why Anglicare? 

We provide meaningful opportunities and choice - for the individuals and communities we support, and for the dedicated people who make it happen. 

At Anglicare, you'll enjoy the security and support of a well-established organisation, while being empowered to shape a rewarding career. You'll belong to a community of kind, humble and respectful people of all faiths and backgrounds. 

Benefits include: 

Flexible work options to support work-life balance 

Salary packaging - up to $15,900 tax-free income, plus $2,650 for meals and entertainment 

Ongoing professional development and leadership training 

Discounts at over 400 retailers and access to Fitness Passport 

Employee Assistance Program for you and your family 

Are you ready for a career that means more? 

Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the customers and communities we support. While we are guided by our Christian-based values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds who share our commitment to serving others. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders, abilities and cultural backgrounds.

We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

result.description:
The Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer who will single-handedly analyse, design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack operational systems serving Chinese clients across semiconductor, MCU, and cross-border business domains. This is not a narrowly scoped position — the successful candidate must independently manage the complete lifecycle of multiple concurrent software systems, from requirements gathering with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders through to production deployment on China-compliant infrastructure.

The role requires a rare combination of full-stack software engineering, hands-on Linux server administration, working familiarity with IC design and EDA tool environments, and the ability to operate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese across technical, business, and compliance contexts. The candidate will be the primary technical owner of all systems and must be capable of working without supervision across all layers of the stack and across all stages of delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack web applications end-to-end — including React or Vue front-end interfaces, Python-based backend services, relational databases, RESTful APIs, authentication systems, and administrative dashboards — within a single-engineer ownership model.
- Build and maintain internal tools, management systems, workflow dashboards, and client-facing operational platforms for cross-border Chinese SMEs, semiconductor companies, and engineering teams, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms (WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-specific cloud APIs) using Chinese-language API documentation.
- Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and workflow automation systems that support IC design operations, including DFT workflows, Verilog-based digital logic design, verification pipelines, and EDA tool environments (Cadence and Synopsys) — covering environment configuration, licence server management, and build-flow automation.
- Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain applications on Linux-based server environments across Mainland China and international infrastructure, including ICP-filed domains, China-based hosting, cross-border DNS and CDN configuration, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and environment-specific application configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues specific to China-facing deployments, including Great Firewall constraints and dual-environment architectures.
- Identify technology limitations, performance bottlenecks, and process gaps across existing systems, then independently design, implement, and document improvements — maintaining technical documentation, API references, deployment runbooks, and operational procedures in both English and Chinese.
- Analyse operational metrics, system performance data, user feedback, and error reports to drive continuous improvement across all systems under management.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for bilingual teams, Chinese clients, and stakeholders across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia, conducting requirements gathering and technical communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Technical Requirements

Required

- Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complete systems from front-end to backend to deployment.
- Strong proficiency in Python as a primary backend language, with production experience in Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building database-backed web applications and API services.
- Production experience developing front-end interfaces using React or Vue (not merely prototyping), including state management, component architecture, API integration, and responsive design.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining internal tools, admin panels, operational dashboards, and workflow management platforms for business users.
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design, relational database modelling (PostgreSQL or MySQL), authentication and authorisation systems, third-party API integration, and system-to-system communication patterns.
- Hands-on Linux server administration experience, including setup, configuration, application deployment, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS management, firewall rules, log management, cron jobs, process supervision, and production troubleshooting — not merely development on Linux.
- Practical experience with Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and cloud or hybrid server deployment environments.
- Working knowledge of digital IC design workflows, including an understanding of DFT (Design for Test) concepts, Verilog HDL, digital logic design, synthesis, and verification processes — sufficient to develop, configure, and maintain software tools and workflow integrations that support IC design engineering teams.
- Direct experience working with EDA tool environments, specifically Cadence and/or Synopsys toolchains, including at least one of: tool installation and environment configuration, licence server setup and management, build-flow scripting and automation, or integration of EDA tools into broader engineering workflow platforms.
- Familiarity with ARM Cortex and/or RISC-V processor architectures and MCU-based development workflows, with sufficient understanding to build and maintain software systems that support semiconductor engineering and production operations.
- Demonstrated experience with Mainland China infrastructure and compliance requirements, including ICP filing processes, China-based hosting configuration, China-accessible domain and DNS setup, and deployment of applications that function reliably behind the Great Firewall.
- Experience building operational software systems for Chinese businesses, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms, services, or APIs (e.g., WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-based cloud providers), with the ability to independently read and implement from Chinese-language technical documentation.

Preferred

- Experience developing automation scripts, engineering workflow tools, internal development platforms, or integration layers specifically for semiconductor or IC design teams in China.
- Understanding of MCU, semiconductor, embedded systems, or IC design industries in Greater China and broader Asia, particularly where software platforms support engineering, production, or client delivery workflows.
- Experience with software performance optimisation, security hardening, monitoring and alerting systems, and deployment automation for production environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
- Familiarity with cross-border data handling, dual-environment deployment architectures (China/international), and the operational constraints of running software services that must function in both mainland Chinese and international network environments simultaneously.
- Experience working in small teams or as a sole technical operator with full ownership of systems from requirements through to production support.

Language & Communication

- Proficient in English.
- Fluent Mandarin Chinese, both spoken and written, is required.
- Ability to communicate technical requirements, system issues, software specifications, and deployment matters with Chinese clients and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
- Ability to read and interpret Chinese platform documentation, API documentation, compliance materials, and technical communication; draft technical communications in Chinese for mainland stakeholders; and navigate Chinese-language developer resources, forums, and support channels without assistance.

Build the software that protects our most security-conscious organisations.

Most software developers improve products. Here, you'll help redefine them. At Janusnet, our software protects some of Australia's most security-conscious organisations across government, defence and critical infrastructure.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Senior C++ / COM Developer to modernise existing products, help shape our next generation of security solutions, and bring entirely new products to market.

If you're looking for a role where your ideas influence product direction not just sprint tickets this is it.

The Perks

    Hybrid working (50/50 between home and our North Sydney office)
    Build new cybersecurity products from the ground up
    Variety across architecture, product development, innovation and emerging technologies
    Job stability and growth 

What You'll Be Doing
You'll play a key role in modernising our existing suite of trusted security solutions while designing and developing new products that respond to evolving customer needs and emerging technologies.

Working across the full software development lifecycle, you'll build secure, high-quality Windows applications using C++ and COM, applying Secure by Design principles to solutions relied upon by government, defence and critical infrastructure organisations.

Along the way, you'll collaborate with talented engineers and cross-functional teams, influence technical direction and product strategy, and contribute to a culture of innovation as we continue to expand and bring new ideas to market.

What We're Looking For:

    Extensive commercial C++ development experience
    Strong Microsoft COM and Windows development
    Experience across the full software development lifecycle Experience building commercial software productsSecure software development experience
    Experience with server and endpoint security products, security frameworks like Secure by Design, NIST or compliance standards DISP or ISM will put you well ahead.

Australian Citizenship is essential, along with the ability to obtain a Baseline Security Clearance.

Why Janusnet?

For more than 20 years, Janusnet has been developing trusted information security solutions used by government, defence and commercial organisations across Australia and around the world.

We're big enough to work on complex, meaningful security challenges, but still small enough that every engineer has genuine influence over the products we build.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to challenge ideas, innovate, and help shape technology that protects organisations where security matters most.

If you're ready to build software that genuinely makes a difference, and want the opportunity to influence products from concept through to release we'd love to hear from you!

For a confidential discussion, connect with Victoria Williams on 03 9691 4712.

Ready chart a new course?
